information.description:
The basic rough-and-tumble fighters of the Valentinos are courageous, ready to prove their loyalty at the drop of a hate, and always prepared for a fight. They’re not the best in a fight anyway, but hey at least they’re brave.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Valentinos).

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
A cybernetical replacement leg. Comes with a free foot.
Built-in hydraulics negates penalty for jumping. Must be paired.
